entries.text: Needs attention on Home has a Dismiss all button, on the widget and on each group, to clear several cards at once.
For directors and secretaries, the overdue team list in Needs attention now only holds work created by managers and above. A Super Admin can change that level in God Mode.
Opening the inbox now marks its notifications as read after a couple of seconds.
Inbox notifications older than 7 days are archived automatically every day. A Super Admin can change the number of days, switch to deleting them, or turn the cleanup off in God Mode.
